overview.description: The Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust ETF (MSSE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long eth, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that seeks to track the price performance of spot Ether (ETH). The trust will hold Ether directly, secured through a multi-layer cold storage wallet MSSE was launched on Jul 27, 2026 and is issued by Morgan Stanley.
